description:
GitHub is expanding Copilot beyond code generation and developer assistance, launching a redesigned Copilot app and a new Projects capability that enables teams to coordinate multiple AI agents, share context from tools and repositories, and manage software development workflows from a single platform.

title: GitHub bets on multi-agent software development with Copilot overhaul

A trillion-parameter AI model that its developer says could help attackers carry out real cyberattacks is now free to download, modify and run outside the developer’s control.

Mistral AI released the open weights of Mistral Large 4, which it calls “Le Chonk,” on Thursday, weeks after putting the multimodal model into public preview. The Paris-based company said it had monitored cybersecurity-related use of the preview in live traffic.

title: Mistral open-sources AI model despite warning it could aid cyberattacks

description: People have discovered AI agents running on cloud-based platforms, and suddenly, those agents are the answer to every bit of financial and operational friction in their lives. Move money from one bank account to another to chase a better interest rate. Pay bills automatically. Analyze spending patterns. Optimize subscriptions. Question fees. Move funds before a payment clears. Find the cheaper service. Make the decision, click the button, save the human from having to think about it. Everyone seems to think they are being very slick.
title: AI agents are upending digital business processes
